name: mod-settings-sweep
about: All 42 current feature modules and 3 required libraries loaded: manifest-derived shared-row ownership, every feature/settings row, 41 toggle UI/store off/on, explicit Goldworth/library toggle N/A, keyboard capture including Eat/Courier and controller capture including reserved/cancel/release. The 25 GameKeys rows are presence-only; binding effects remain mod-keys-layout/play/persist. Restores initial effective scalar values. This is settings UI/store/capture evidence, not every feature's functional off/on behavior or physical controller proof. Owned initial snapshots restore from a sweep-level finally after failures; original and cleanup errors are retained independently.
